meta.title: ci: Add conditional testing for wef and webview crates
meta.body_summary: Optimize CI by excluding heavy wef/webview crates from the main test job and running them conditionally only when their code changes, claiming faster CI and resource savings.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot proposed CI conditional testing; huacnlee commented to merge jobs and then took over the PR branch, made several commits, and closed without merge, indicating the design was rejected.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 320 changed lines in a single CI file, this is a small-sized edit by absolute volume. It fits a typical CI optimization PR, but the change was closed despite modest size due to design disagreement.

review_details.concern_detail: huacnlee's inline comments ('Merge to test-wef', '@copilot') suggest that the maintainer preferred merging the separate test-wef and test-webview jobs into a single combined job rather than keeping them separate.
review_details.performance_claim: Significantly improve CI performance by excluding heavy crates and running conditional tests only when relevant code changes.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer took over the PR branch, made several direct commits modifying the CI configuration, then closed the PR without merging, suggesting the proposed job separation was not accepted.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: CI workflow optimization with conditional jobs requires alignment with maintainer preferences for job granularity; Copilot's proposed separate jobs were not accepted, and the maintainer took over to implement their own approach.

detection_detail.code_reading: huacnlee reviewed the YAML diff in ci.yml and requested merging the test-webview job into test-wef via inline comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after CI timing data was provided; only narrative claims of faster CI and YAML syntax validation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After review comments, huacnlee made several direct commits modifying the ci.yml in the PR branch, then closed the PR without merging.

core_change_summary.description: Modified .github/workflows/ci.yml to exclude wef and gpui-webview crates from the main test job and added conditional test-wef and test-webview jobs that run only when their source files change, using dorny/paths-filter@v2.
